Subject: Request for Consideration of a Raise

Dear [Boss's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to reach out and discuss the possibility of a raise, as I believe it would be a fair and appropriate recognition of my contributions to the team and my role in achieving our goals.

Over the past [X months/years], I have consistently delivered results that align with our team's objectives. I have taken on additional responsibilities, contributed to key projects, and have been proactive in ensuring that our goals are met efficiently and effectively. I believe that my efforts have had a positive impact on the team's performance and have been valued by my colleagues and supervisors.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss this matter further and to present any additional information that may support my request. I am open to any feedback or suggestions you may have, and I am committed to continuing to grow and contribute to the team in a meaningful way.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response and am eager to move forward with any next steps.

Best regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Job Title]  
[Your Contact Information]

P.P.S. I would be grateful if you could consider my request and provide your feedback at your earliest convenience.

SUBJECT: REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A RAISE

DEAR [BOSS'S NAME],

I HOPE THIS MESSAGE FINDS YOU WELL. I WANTED TO REACH OUT AND DISCUSS THE POSSIBILITY OF A RAISE, AS I BELIEVE IT WOULD BE A FAIR AND APPROPRIATE RECOGNITION OF MY CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE TEAM AND MY ROLE IN ACHIEVING OUR GOALS.

OVER THE PAST [X MONTHS/YEARS], I HAVE CONSISTENTLY DELIVERED RESULTS THAT ALIGN WITH OUR TEAM'S OBJECTIVES. I HAVE TAKEN ON ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES, CONTRIBUTED TO KEY PROJECTS, AND HAVE BEEN PROACTIVE IN ENURING THAT OUR GOALS ARE MET EFFICIENTLY AND EFFECTIVELY. I BELIEVE THAT MY EFFORTS HAVE HAD A POSITIVE IMPACT ON THE TEAM'S PERFORMANCE AND HAVE BEEN VALUED BY MY COLLEAGUES AND SUPERVISORS.

I WOULD APPRECIATE THE OPPORTUNITY TO DISCUSS THIS MATTER FURTHER AND TO PRESENT ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION THAT MAY SUPPORT MY REQUEST. I AM OPEN TO ANY FEEDBACK OR SUGGESTIONS YOU MAY HAVE, AND I AM COMMITTED TO CONTINUING TO GROW AND CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM IN A MEANINGFUL WAY.

THANK YOU FOR YOUR TIME AND CONSIDERATION. I LOOK FORWARD TO YOUR RESPONSE AND ARE EAGER TO MOVE FORWARD WITH ANY NEXT STEPS.

BEST RESPECTS,  
[YOUR FULL NAME]  
[YOUR JOB TITLE]  
[YOUR CONTACT INFORMATION]

P.P.S. I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF YOU COULD CONSIDER MY REQUEST AND PROVIDE YOUR FEEDBACK AT YOUR EARLIEST CONVENIENCE.

HOPE YOU AGREE WITH ME.

Dear [Boss's Name],  

I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to respectfully ask for consideration of a raise for the current fiscal year. Over the past [X] months, I have consistently met or exceeded my goals, contributed positively to team projects, and have taken initiative to improve my skills and efficiency.  

I believe that my efforts and dedication have warranted a review of my compensation. I am confident that my contributions have had a meaningful impact on the team and the overall success of our projects. I would greatly appreciate the opportunity to discuss this matter further and to explore the possibility of a raise that reflects my current role and responsibilities.  

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response and to the possibility of discussing this matter in more detail.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]

[Your Name]
